title.narrative: Improving access to multisectoral Life saving services through integrated Nutrition and EORE Services

description.narrative:
ltp style="" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-US"gtLABDI is a national organization that operates across the BAY states and implements activities in areas of nutrition, WASH, Protection, and Education. In this project, LABDI will engage in improving access to quality nutrition preventive and curative activities and providing explosive ordnance risk education (EORE) safety messages to at-risk persons. Children, PLWs including IDPs, returnees, and host community members will be the key targets of the project.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-US"gtLife At Best Development Initiative will work in consortium by sub-granting the implementation in two LGAs to Grow Strong Foundation (GSF). The implementing partners will work together to provide Explosive Ordinance Risk Education to four Local Government Areas (LGAs) comprising of Ngala, Dikwa, Damboa and Gwoza in Borno State reaching a total of 25000 project beneficiaries.ltbrgtLABDI will precisely work in Ngala and Dikwa LGA and GSF will work in Damboa and Gwoza LGA respectively.lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-US"gt lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-US"gtLABDI will implement all the nutrition activities. Beneficiaries will be admitted into the nutrition programs and receive treatment according to the national guidelines while preventive nutrition services will be provided to caregivers and beneficiaries to prevent and reduce the incidence of malnutrition. LABDI is implementing the nutrition project by strengthening the screening, identification and referral of acute malnutrition among children under five, pregnant and lactating women (PLW) ensuring that malnourished children receive timely treatment quality nutrition services and ensuring provision of support for appropriate, safe feeding for children 0-23 months (specific focus on lt6m) in Borno state. In this project, LABDI will also ensure pregnant and lactating women, children under 5, adolescents and other members of the targeted communities receive quality nutrition services by, providing supplies, supporting the daily provision of curative nutrition services in health facilities and community, and other various interventions to reduce morbidity and mortality. The project will also treat children and PLWs with MAM through the Tom Brown approach. lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-US"gt lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-US"gtThe project will provide capacity building to government healthcare providers and in the prevention and treatment of severe acute malnutrition through promotion of appropriate infant and young children feeding (IYCF) practices, community mobilization, identification and referral of SAM cases and treatment of severe acute malnutrition (SAM) among children less than 5 years in Outpatient Therapeutic Program (OTP) and also ensuring those with medical complications are referred to Stabilization center. ltbrgtltbrgtLABDI will implement preventive and curative nutrition activities in Damboa general Hospital Shuwari and Damboa Central Primary Health of Damboa LGA, and Bulabulin and ajari (Kanumbu) of Dikwa LGA. lt/spangtlt/pgt
